_comment: Revision 2 of acceptance_dialogue_30.json (phase 7 B.4). The base plan is unchanged and stays bound to its hash;
this file only overrides rounds that no kept test directory has reached yet (tools/replay.py load_plan refuses otherwise).
Round 15: in the base plan it came 30 hours after round 14, but round 4 put the defense on 下周三 (the Wednesday of
the week after round 4). Round 15 now happens the morning after that Wednesday, so 答辩结束了 is said after the
defense date. The stored event and its content are not touched.

time._meaning: 第 4 轮说的“下周三”（第 4 轮所在周的下一周星期三）的第二天上午 10 点
